headline: JPMorgan's global strategy team says this month's AI stock sell-off is unlikely to bounce back as fast as July's did.
score_reason: One bank's market view reported by MarketWatch; facts support the pool score.
importance_line: The view warns holders of AI chip stocks that a quick recovery is not assured, but it is one bank's reading of market positioning and a forecast, not a fact.
summary: MarketWatch reports that Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou of JPMorgan's global strategy team says fewer investors are buying dips, company share buybacks have dwindled and fewer bets against shares are left to fuel a rebound. He argues AI infrastructure stocks "do not appear oversold from a positioning or flow perspective", and notes SK Hynix and Samsung have fallen almost a third in a month.
notes: The pool item is Quartz's version (qz.com), which returned 403; MarketWatch's original on the same JPMorgan note was read via Longbridge and is credited instead. The report credits Dow Jones/MarketWatch.
